# AH Marketing Agency (এ এইচ মার্কেটিং এজেন্সি)

> Ethical, halal digital marketing agency in Khilkhet, Dhaka, Bangladesh. Works in Bangla and English with small and medium businesses across Bangladesh and abroad.

## Services
- Social media management: Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn (content calendar, Bangla and English posts)
- Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads and lead generation, with pixel and conversion tracking
- Website and e-commerce development (bKash/card payments, courier integration, basic SEO)
- Logo design and branding (brand kit: colours, fonts)
- Video, reels and content creation, including Bangla voice
- Marketing automation, WhatsApp Business and IT support

## Values
- Honest content, no misleading ads, nothing against Islamic values
- Written quotation before work, with clear scope, cost and timeline
